speaker_role: unknown (UC San Diego Housing/Dining/Hospitality staff, not admissions officers)
key_insights: This webinar covers UCSD's on-campus housing and dining logistics (contracts, dining plans, allergen program, family housing) for admitted/prospective students, not admissions criteria or strategy.
States UCSD offers a two-year on-campus housing guarantee for incoming first-years and transfers, contingent on living on campus continuously and meeting all application deadlines.
Describes the dining plan as an a-la-carte, dollar-balance system that rolls over across the year rather than a per-week swipe system common elsewhere.

Mentions students with documented medical/dietary needs should register with the Office of Students with Disabilities immediately after accepting admission, since that office can take weeks to schedule an appointment.

Briefly states 2026 application-cycle facts: one UC application covers all nine UC campuses, fee is $80 domestic/$95 international per campus, decisions arrive by March 31, and admits must reply by May 1.
specific_numbers_or_facts: Speakers: UC application fee $80 per campus domestic, $95 per campus international; fee waivers cover up to 4 campuses
Speakers: Fall 2026 decisions released by March 31, 2026; reply-by date May 1, 2026
Speakers: housing contract prepayment cited as $450
notable_or_distinctive: Essentially a housing/dining operations webinar rather than an admissions-strategy resource; only the closing minute touches admissions timeline facts.
reliability_notes: Off-topic for admissions strategy/insight purposes (this is campus-life logistics for one specific school); the few admissions dates given (fall 2026 cycle) are current and specific to UCSD only, not generalizable.
